tasks.description: Derive generic declarative equations, typed units and global coupling; decide A coupled/B multirate/C exponential for nonlinear stiff neuroscience without anatomical branches.
Implement and measure shared CPU/GPU equation compiler, scan, snapshot and transactional modifications; run numerical/invalidation falsifiers.
Review actual source and traces for proposed fast/precise tolerances, mutation rollback and unsupported models; external reviewer, no automatic scientific promotion.
